doors.alt: Almond carriage house garage door with arched glass, Peoria AZ
doors.caption: Amarr Classica 3000 carriage house in almond. Triple layer, 2in polyurethane, R-13.35, Tuscany panel with Seine arched glass and Blue Ridge decorative hardware.

doors.alt: Terracotta long panel steel garage door with tinted gray windows, Tortosa in Maricopa AZ
doors.caption: Clopay Classic Steel long panel in terracotta. Vinyl-backed insulated steel around R-7.0, with Tinted Gray glass set mid-row instead of the usual top row.

doors.caption: Amarr Vista 1000 full view aluminum in Quaker Bronze with Frost glass. ClearView aluminum strut system and WaterLok joint sealing.
